decisions.reason: As a close extension of the firm's core hosting and service business, premium support likely meets or stays near aspiration levels and uses existing support resources efficiently, so management would tend to retain it.

The version management tool builds on the firm's software and platform capabilities, so even if standalone results are mixed, organizational slack and complementarities with the core offer support keeping it for now.

Because the data-processing-contract tool is relatively distant from the firm's main hosting and support focus, any performance shortfall is more likely to trigger problemistic search and reallocation of resources back to core services or nearer development projects.

Scalable hosting for agencies is close to the established business, was highlighted as a flagship direction, and fits the firm's key resources so strongly that management would be unlikely to withdraw it unless results were clearly far below aspiration.
